_what: FONT OPTIONS, not a deliverable cut. Five renders of the SAME main title card, differing only in how PROJECT BLUEFIN is set, so the owner can pick one by looking at it over the real frame instead of reading a description of it. Rendered by cards/render-cards.mjs into renders/font-options/ and composited over the source frame at 15.400 by scripts/build_font_options.py.
_owner: 2026-08-16: 'the Project Bluefin is a tad too thin on the font, give me some options, the title itself is perfect'. So `.title` is identical in all five and only the eyebrow moves.
_why_not_500_and_600: The card's stack is the site's -- 'Inter', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif -- and Inter is not installed on this host, so it falls to DejaVu Sans, which has Book (400) and Bold (700) and nothing between. font-weight 500 would snap to Book and 600 to Bold, so a 400/500/600/700 option set would be two options wearing four names. The variants use the levers that exist instead: weight, stroke width, contrast and size. See cards/maintitle.html.
_copy: Every card reproduces the prologue's committed strings exactly -- stories/00-prologue-plates.json -- including the credit line, so what the owner is choosing between is the typography and nothing else.
